def make_inputs() -> list:
    device = torch.device("cuda")
    return [
        torch.randn((BATCH_SIZE, SEQ_LEN, HIDDEN_SIZE), device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16),
        torch.randn((BATCH_SIZE, SEQ_LEN, HIDDEN_SIZE), device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16),
        torch.randn((HIDDEN_SIZE,), device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.1 + 1.0,
        torch.randn((INTERMEDIATE_SIZE, HIDDEN_SIZE), device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16) / math.sqrt(HIDDEN_SIZE),
        torch.randn((INTERMEDIATE_SIZE, HIDDEN_SIZE), device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16) / math.sqrt(HIDDEN_SIZE),
        torch.randn((HIDDEN_SIZE, INTERMEDIATE_SIZE), device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
        / math.sqrt(INTERMEDIATE_SIZE),
        1e-05,
    ]
